[P. 8, middle block, top (across the second and third columns from the right), framed; original in Yiddish]
The Land of Israel — in word and picture!
Just published: the newest illustrated book
by Moshe Mark
"On the Roads
of the Land of Israel"
40 articles and feuilletons
28 pictures and illustrations
By the overland route to the Land of Israel
Descriptions of all the towns and colonies
Interviews with prominent personalities
Travel impressions from 10 countries.
With a foreword by the well-known writer S. Szachnowicz
De luxe edition • 240 large pages • artistic cover
Price, paperbound, only 4.80 zł.
Libraries: booksellers' discount; not sent cash-on-delivery, money in advance.
Available at Szpigelman's bookshop, Będzin, Kołłątaja 34.
—o—
[Advertisement — pharmaceuticals; Warsaw.]
[P. 8, second column from the right, top; original in Polish]
[Picture: powder package]
Sweat
and its unpleasant odour
are removed by
SUDORYN
Ap. Kowalski
Warsaw
Powder with sifter
—o—
[Notice — private notice (warning to the "Yesodei HaTorah" cheder); Będzin.]
[P. 8, second column from the right, middle; original in Yiddish]
Warning!
Since my house borders
on the house of the "Yesodei
HaTorah" cheder in Będzin, and the boundary wall, which is
soaked through by the privy pit, is in danger of collapsing,
which could, God forbid, cause human victims,
I warn for the last time the heads of the
cheder that by Friday of the week of Devarim 5694 they must put
in order the dangerous wall and the pit. If
not, I shall hand the matter over to the supervisory
authority. Incidentally, I note that the local rabbinate [printed "rapinat"; probably "rabinat" ?]
too, which was on the spot, has established
that the wall could cause a catastrophe.
471 Emanuel Fajnski [?], Będzin, Małachowskiego 26.
—o—
[Advertisement — anti-perspiration liquid; Warsaw.]
[P. 8, second column from the right, bottom, illustrated; original in Polish]
Sweat
and its unpleasant odour
are removed by the liquid
SUDOR
"AP. KOWALSKI"
WARSAW
[Picture: a bottle]
—o—
[Advertisement — medicine (pills); Warsaw.]
[P. 8, third column from the right, top, framed with a picture of a monk; original in Yiddish, maker and address in Polish]
Reformation Pills
[Picture: a monk holding a jug]
with the trademark "Monk", the best known[?] since the year
1602, regulate the stomach, protect against[?] rheu-
matism, liver ailments, take away[?] corpulence,
arthritism[?], the rush of blood to the head,
soothe the pains of haemorrhoids, cleanse
the blood, and with tendencies to constipation
— a favourable purgative.
To be taken 1 or 2 pills at night.
Price per box 1.35. Made by
Aptekarz Tuszyński, Warszawa,
Smolna 22. Ask for them in pharmacies
and drugstores — with the monk (zakonnik)
—o—
[Advertisement — private sale (sewing machine); Sosnowiec.]
[P. 8, third column from the right, middle, right-hand box; original in Yiddish]
A new sewing machine
in the best condition
for sale on occasion
at Piekarski's [?], Sosnowiec,
Modrzejowska 25,
tel. 751.
464
—o—
[Notice — the paper's administration; Będzin.]
[P. 8, third column from the right, middle, left-hand box; original in Yiddish]
Akiba Wajnsztok
of Będzin is requested
to report to the
administration of our
newspaper concerning his
documents.
0[?]
—o—
[Advertisement — pharmaceuticals; Warsaw.]
[P. 8, third column from the right, bottom; original in Polish]
[Picture: heart in a ring]
«KOWALSKINA»
powders
are used
for persistent
HEADACHES
Only with the mark
"Heart in a ring"
Chemical-Pharmaceutical Factory "Ap. Kowalski", Warsaw
—o—
[Notice — "Linat HaCholim" (maternity home); Będzin.]
[P. 8, left column, top; original in Yiddish]
Warning!
Because it has already
happened several times
that irresponsible people have come in the late
hours to our maternity home
without any prior arrangement, we warn
that if this happens, the person concerned
will by no means be admitted as long as the proper
formalities have not been completed. 468
Maternity home of the "Linat HaCholim", Będzin.
—o—
[Advertisement — bookshop (waste paper); Będzin.]
[P. 8, left column, below the warning; original in Yiddish]
Old newspapers
(waste paper)
available at Szpigelman's bookshop.
—o—
[Advertisement — herbal medicine; no town given.]
[P. 8, left column, middle; original in Yiddish, product name in Polish]
[Picture: five doctors before an anatomical chart of the digestive system]
Save your health
The world's most famous doctors have established
that 75% of illnesses arise
from constipation.
A sick stomach is the most important cause of
the onset of illnesses — it pollutes the
blood and creates a bad metabolism.
ZIOŁA Z GÓR HARCU
of Dr. Lauer
As the greatest doctors have established,
they are an ideal means of making
the stomach healthy, remove constipation, are a mild
purgative [?]. They ease the task
of the digestive organs, strengthen the
organism and awaken the appetite.
ZIOŁA Z GÓR HARCU of Dr. Lauer
remove the ailments of the liver, kidneys, gallstones,
haemorrhoid ailments, rheumatism, and
arthritism [?].
Price per box 1.50 zł.;
a double box 2.60 [?] zł.
Available at pharmacies and drugstores.
—o—
[Advertisement — the paper's own house ad (Zaglembier Tsaytung); Zagłębie.]
[P. 8, left column, bottom; original in Yiddish]
Ask in all spa and summer-cottage (dacha) resorts for the
"Zaglembier
Tsaytung"
—o—
[Notice — the paper's administration (rates); Będzin.]
[P. 8, bottom strip across the page; original in Polish]
ADVERTISING RATES: Per 1 millimetre line: before the text (8 columns) 40 gr., after the text (8 columns) 20 gr., within the text (5 columns) 60 gr., death notices (8 columns) 15 gr.
The administration is not responsible for printing on a set date or for keeping the placement of advertisements. —— Cheque account P.K.O. Warsaw No. 60.849.

Ostrzeżenie!
Ponieważ mój dom graniczy
z domem chederu „Jesodej
ha-Tora” w Będzinie, a mur graniczny, przesiąknięty
z dołu kloacznego, grozi zawaleniem,
co może, uchowaj Boże, spowodować ofiary w ludziach,
ostrzegam po raz ostatni zarząd
chederu, aby do piątku [tygodnia] paraszy Dewarim 5694 doprowadzili
do porządku niebezpieczny mur i dół. Jeśli
nie, przekażę sprawę władzy
nadzorczej. Nawiasem mówiąc, zaznaczam, że także miejscowy rabinat [w druku „rapinat”; ?],
który był na miejscu, stwierdził,
że przez ten mur może dojść do katastrofy.
471 Emanuel Fajnski [?], Będzin, Małachowskiego 26.

usuwa PŁYN

WARSZAWA
